reuse.why: Builds on monthUtils.dayFromDate and puts the new matching in one exported helper that every existing holiday check now calls.

duplication.why: The three separate holiday membership checks (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getDatesInRange) are merged into one isHoliday function, so no copies are left.

placement.why: isHoliday sits in shared/schedules.ts beside getDateWithSkippedWeekend, and the server imports it from #shared/schedules the same way it imports the other date helpers.

scope.why: Focused, but it also includes Prettier reflows of unrelated lines in schedules.ts and schedules.test.ts and an import reorder in app.test.ts.

maintainability.why: The holiday rule now has one small, well-named definition, so changing the format later touches one place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; every holiday check goes through the new isHoliday

disguised_duplication.where: none; the duplicated checks were removed rather than reshaped
